newsitem.title: USA: American Exploration, Tom Brown set venture.
newsitem.headline: American Exploration, Tom Brown set venture.

text.p: American Exploration Co said Thursday it has formed an exploration venture with Tom Brown Inc in the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef Trend of East Texas.

American Exploration said it will participate for a 40 percent working interest ownership and expects to invest a total of $10-$15 million in acreage, seismic and drilling in 1996 and 1997. Tom Brown will hold a 60 percent working interest and serve as operator of the properties.

The venture covers some 50,000 gross (40,000 net) acres held under lease or options in Anderson, Cherokee and Smith counties, Texas. To date, numerous pinnacle reef prospect leads have been identified on the venture acreage using 2-D seismic data, American Exploration said.
A 76 square mile proprietary 3-D seismic survey is currently being conducted over a portion of the acreage and the initial exploratory well is expected to start drilling in 1997.

"We have been studying the Cotton Valley Reef Trend for some time and feel that this joint venture offers the best way for us to establish a meaningful position," American Exploration said. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
